applicableAreas: Retaining wall locations if adjacent to transformer pads

applicableAreas: All transformer pads adjacent to sidewalks

Access door orientation is not indicated on the electrical plans. Without knowing which direction the access door faces, the 10-foot clearance requirement to open area or adjacent buildings cannot be verified.
Access door orientation is not indicated on the plans. Cannot determine if any transformer location faces a confined space (niche, vault, or enclosed area on 3+ sides) requiring 15-foot clearance.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad 4 proximity to fire hydrant
findings.comment: Proposed fire hydrants are shown on the Fire Protection Plan. Transformer pad 4 appears to be located near a fire hydrant, but the 5-foot clearance distance is not dimensioned.

Landscape plan (Sheet 31) does not show transformer pad locations, making it impossible to verify that trees within 10 lateral feet of pads are utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F. Tree species are documented (Sheet 32) but their relationship to transformers cannot be verified.
Landscape plan does not show transformer pad locations, making verification of shrub clearances (10 feet from access door side, 5 feet from other sides) impossible.

applicableAreas: Trees within 20 feet of underground electric equipment
findings.comment: No root barrier details are shown or referenced on any plans. Transformer pad locations relative to trees are not documented on landscape plans, so tree-to-transformer proximity cannot be verified.
Fire lanes are designated on Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10), but transformer pads are not shown on that plan. Distance from transformer pads to fire lanes cannot be verified.
Four transformer pads are shown but the distances between them are not dimensioned. Minimum 5-foot clearance between transformer pads cannot be verified.
Water lines are shown on utility plans but clearances from transformer pads are not dimensioned. Cannot verify 5-foot horizontal clearance from water lines.
Wastewater lines are shown on utility plans but clearances from transformer pads are not dimensioned. Cannot verify 5-foot horizontal clearance from wastewater lines.
Storm drain lines are shown on plans but clearances from transformer pads are not dimensioned. Cannot verify 5-foot horizontal clearance from storm drain lines.
Overhead electric line is shown on landscape plan but horizontal sky-to-ground clearances from transformer pads are not dimensioned. Cannot verify 7.5-foot horizontal clearance requirement.
Overhead distribution line is shown but 15-foot radius clearance from primary and neutral conductors is not documented or dimensioned.

No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances for overhead structures, parking areas, or enclosed areas. Transformer pads are shown only on preliminary electrical plan without vertical clearance documentation.

Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified on any plans. Grading plan (Sheet 11) does not show transformer pad locations or drainage slopes around them. Cannot verify drainage flows away from transformer pad locations.
Site plan does not clearly dimensioned show transformer pad positions relative to property lines. Cannot verify that pads are 100% on private property and not straddling property boundaries.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad 2 in vault easement; Transformer pad 3 in drainage easement
findings.comment: Transformer pad 2 is labeled in a 'Vault Easement' and transformer pad 3 appears to be in a '25' Drainage Easement.' No Austin Energy Design written approval is documented for placement in these restricted easements.

No transformer easements are shown on the site plan or electrical plan around any of the four transformer pad locations. Easement boundaries and widths required for Austin Energy accessibility are not depicted.
Electrical routing from transformers to meters is shown schematically on electrical plan but specific routing to confirm 100% private property placement is not detailed.

No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are included in the plan set. Transformer pad dimensions are not provided. Service type (single-phase or three-phase) is not documented. Required AE Design-approved pad details for the specified service type must be provided.

Parking areas and fire lanes are shown on site and fire plans, but proximity of transformer pads to parking/traffic areas is not dimensioned. Bollard requirements and specifications per AE Design details are not provided.
